text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine!
As they say, "even Umamusume run backward sometimes," so please don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, it made me really happy
that you worked so hard for my sake, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much
for taking on this challenge so seriously.
It ended in a disappointing result...
